text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Waghh! There it is!
And somehow it looks stronger than before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわ、
いたッス！
なんか
さっきより強そうに見えるッス……

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: I get the impression it was lying in wait for us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
準備万端って感じで
待ち構えてるね。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh? Works for me.
Let's have ourselves a blast, fist to claw!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ、
いいじゃねえか。
存分に楽しもうぜ、
このケンカを！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, forget worrying!
Let's just do this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうなりゃヤケです！
いくですよ！！
